exports.name: ResizableDirective
exports.summary:
Place this on an element to make it resizable. For example: ```html
``` Or in case they are sibling elements: ```html
```
exports.summaryZh: 将此指令用于元素使其可缩放，可配合 {@link ResizeHandleDirective} 作为独立的拖拽手柄。

inputs.name: validateResize
inputs.description: A function that will be called before each resize event. Return `true` to allow the resize event to propagate or `false` to cancel it
inputs.descriptionZh: 输入属性 `validateResize`（类型：`(resizeEvent: ResizeEvent) => boolean`），用于配置校验调整尺寸。

inputs.name: enableGhostResize
inputs.description: Set to `true` to enable a temporary resizing effect of the element in between the `resizeStart` and `resizeEnd` events.
inputs.descriptionZh: 输入属性 `enableGhostResize`（类型：`boolean`），用于配置启用Ghost调整尺寸（默认值：`false`）。

inputs.name: resizeSnapGrid
inputs.description:
A snap grid that resize events will be locked to.

e.g. to only allow the element to be resized every 10px set it to `{left: 10, right: 10}`
inputs.descriptionZh: 输入属性 `resizeSnapGrid`（类型：`Edges`），用于配置调整尺寸吸附网格表格（默认值：`{}`）。

inputs.name: resizeCursors
inputs.description: The mouse cursors that will be set on the resize edges
inputs.descriptionZh: 输入属性 `resizeCursors`（类型：`ResizeCursors`），用于配置调整尺寸光标（默认值：`DEFAULT_RESIZE_CURSORS`）。

inputs.name: ghostElementPositioning
inputs.description: Define the positioning of the ghost element (can be fixed or absolute)
inputs.descriptionZh: 输入属性 `ghostElementPositioning`（类型：`'fixed' | 'absolute'`），用于配置ghost元素位置（默认值：`'fixed'`）。

inputs.name: allowNegativeResizes
inputs.description: Allow elements to be resized to negative dimensions
inputs.descriptionZh: 输入属性 `allowNegativeResizes`（类型：`boolean`），用于配置允许Negative调整尺寸（默认值：`false`）。

inputs.name: mouseMoveThrottleMS
inputs.description: The mouse move throttle in milliseconds, default: 50 ms
inputs.descriptionZh: 输入属性 `mouseMoveThrottleMS`（类型：`number`），用于配置鼠标移动节流毫秒（默认值：`MOUSE_MOVE_THROTTLE_MS`）。

outputs.name: resizeStart
outputs.description: Called when the mouse is pressed and a resize event is about to begin. `$event` is a `ResizeEvent` object.
outputs.descriptionZh: 输出事件 `resizeStart`（类型：`EventEmitter`），当触发调整尺寸开始时向外发出事件。

outputs.name: resizing
outputs.description: Called as the mouse is dragged after a resize event has begun. `$event` is a `ResizeEvent` object.
outputs.descriptionZh: 输出事件 `resizing`（类型：`EventEmitter`），当触发调整尺寸中时向外发出事件。

outputs.name: resizeEnd
outputs.description: Called after the mouse is released after a resize event. `$event` is a `ResizeEvent` object.
outputs.descriptionZh: 输出事件 `resizeEnd`（类型：`EventEmitter`），当触发调整尺寸结束时向外发出事件。

exports.name: ResizeHandleDirective
exports.summary:
Marks an element as a dedicated drag handle that triggers resizing on a sibling/ancestor
element carrying {@link ResizableDirective} (`resizableContainer` or nearest via DI).
exports.summaryZh:
将元素标记为专用的拖拽手柄，拖拽它会触发携带 {@link ResizableDirective} 的
兄弟/祖先元素（通过 `resizableContainer` 或最近的 DI 注入）进行缩放。

inputs.name: resizeEdges
inputs.description: The `Edges` object that contains the edges of the parent element that dragging the handle will trigger a resize on
inputs.descriptionZh: 描述父元素哪些边（edges）会因拖拽该手柄而触发缩放。

inputs.name: resizableContainer
inputs.description: Reference to ResizableDirective in case if handle is not located inside of element with ResizableDirective
inputs.descriptionZh: 当手柄不在带有 {@link ResizableDirective} 的元素内部时，显式指定其引用。

methods.name: onMousedown
methods.descriptionZh: 内部使用，开始跟踪指针移动/抬起，并向配对的 {@link ResizableDirective} 转发按下事件。

methods.name: onMouseup
methods.descriptionZh: 内部使用，停止跟踪指针移动，并向配对的 {@link ResizableDirective} 转发抬起事件。
